name: apprenti.dev Software Quality and Test Engineering Apprenticeship
audience: Developers or QA professionals with solid coding ability who are specializing into test and quality engineering
philosophy: Evidence-driven test engineering: map tests to real risk, measure quality directly instead of by proxy, and defend every gate you add to a pipeline.
aiPrinciples: AI assistance must be disclosed when materially used.
Tasks may restrict solution generation while allowing explanations, hints, quizzes and coaching.
The apprentice remains accountable for every test, quality gate and report submitted.
Mentor approval is based on demonstrated diagnostic and design ability, not on a green pipeline alone.
